How to play

  • Desktop: WASD / arrows to move, mouse-drag to orbit, wheel to zoom, Space to jump, Shift to sprint.
  • Mobile: left joystick to move, drag right half of screen to look, ▲ to jump, ≫ to sprint.
  • Collect all ✦ shards scattered in the meadow. Walk into glowing rings, ponds and groves to find them.
  • Grass, pines, oaks, bushes, rocks, flowers, reeds & mushrooms are all procedurally modeled — no downloads.
